utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: Thanks for joining me. I want to hear how you both actually take notes in lectures.

utterances.speaker: GUEST_A
utterances.text: Happy to be here. It started because my handwriting is slow and my professor talks fast.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: So you record the whole lecture?

utterances.speaker: GUEST_A
utterances.text: Not the whole thing. I keep the microphone off until something lands that I know I will forget.

utterances.speaker: GUEST_B
utterances.text: That is the opposite of what I do. I record everything and sort it out afterwards.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: Does that not leave you with hours of audio to wade through?

utterances.speaker: GUEST_B
utterances.text: It would, if I left it as audio. The transcript is searchable, so I jump straight to the part I need.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: Why does it matter that it runs on your own machine?

utterances.speaker: GUEST_A
utterances.text: The lecture hall has terrible signal, and I did not want my own voice sitting on a server I have never heard of.

utterances.speaker: GUEST_B
utterances.text: Half of my reading list is unpublished work, and I am not allowed to send it anywhere.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: How accurate is it with a strong accent?

utterances.speaker: GUEST_A
utterances.text: Better than I expected, though it still trips over names. I keep a list of terms from my field.

utterances.speaker: GUEST_B
utterances.text: The first week was rough. Then I taught it the words it kept getting wrong, and it settled down.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: Is there anything you would still like it to do?

utterances.speaker: GUEST_A
utterances.text: I would like it to tell me who was speaking. In a seminar the transcript reads like one long paragraph.

utterances.speaker: GUEST_B
utterances.text: And quicker on a laptop with no graphics card, because that is what most students carry.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: That is a fair place to stop. Thank you both.
